summary: Nebuchadnezzar creates a golden image and commands all men to worship it—Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego refuse and are cast into the fiery furnace—They are preserved and come out unharmed.
meta_description: Nebuchadnezzar creates a golden image and commands all men to worship it—Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego refuse and are cast into the fiery furnace—They are preserved and come out unharmed.

footnotes.note5_b: The Aramaic word denotes a triangular stringed instrument.
footnotes.note28_c: IE were successful in defying the king’s decree.
